description: Text-bearing blocks (text, rich text, field label, totals rows, totals) expose a Typography panel: size, weight (with numeric value), line height, align, style, color.
Data Fields expose a 'Value Text' typography panel for the bound value.
Canvas renders authored typography (size, weight, line height, align, style, color) on text, field values and totals.
Layer names persist across save/reopen via an optional presentation-only `name` on template AST nodes; unrenamed layers export no name.
Default layer names use the first free number per block type ('Box Container 1').
Insertion rule: selected container receives the block; selected leaf gets it as next sibling; nothing/page selected appends to the page; climbs to the nearest accepting ancestor.
The page accepts every block type except legacy columns, so Sections are optional.
Inserted blocks become the selection and an 'Added X to Y' message confirms where they went.
Blocks palette shows where the next block goes and an Inside it / After it switch for selected containers; Shift+click on '+' inserts after the selection.
Canvas shows an insertion marker (line or highlighted empty container) for the next insert.
Outline is always visible below the palette, keeps collapse state, scrolls only its own pane, and marks the selection with aria-selected.
Arrange toolbar: move earlier/later, move out of / into container, copy, paste, duplicate, copy style, paste style, delete, with hints.
Keyboard: arrows reorder, Alt+Left/Right move out/in, Ctrl/Cmd+C/X/V/D copy/cut/paste/duplicate, Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+C/V copy/paste style; keys from panels and open dropdowns never reach the block.
Paste and duplicate create fresh ids, drop the source AST id, and give unique layer names; focus moves to the copy's layer name.
Renaming a copied block offers to rename its inner layers sharing the old prefix/suffix.
Delete selects the next sibling, else previous, else the containing block (never the page).
Escape in the inspector leaves the field first; Escape from a dropdown never deselects the block.
Unified Size control: width Auto/Fill/Fit/Fixed and height Auto/Fixed with one value input each, plus inline min/max; X/Y/W/H inputs and the Apply button removed.
New flow blocks are content-sized; media keep a frame; logo height is auto with a 72px cap.
Per-side padding and margin editor with an explicit 'Same on all sides' toggle; clearing a side never resets the others.
Padding lives in Style > Appearance for every block type (container padding included).
Inspector tabs Content / Style / Layout & size with a sticky selection; Content tab hidden when a block has nothing to fill in; new blocks open on Content.
Inspector panels show an 'N set' count and a dot on set fields, where 'set' means different from a new block's default; designer-only fields never count.
'Set on this block' summary lists all overrides across tabs (schema fields, container layout, size) and jumps to the editing tab.
Placeholders read 'e.g. …' in italics so empty fields do not look set.
Copy style / paste style transfers visual style (and container layout) but not size, as one undo step.
Section uses the container inspector (no duplicated layout controls).
Live-typing an emptied field keeps it empty (no default reappearing); blur commits the unset value.
Enum fields show numeric values (e.g. imported font weight 700) and treat 'Default' as unset; the 'Select…' entry is gone from designer dropdowns.
Image/Logo source can be 'Company logo' (binding) or a custom image; Logo blocks default to the company logo and reopen as Logo blocks.
Export binds the company logo to the document kind's logo path; imported logo bindings are preserved verbatim.
Table columns: width and alignment are column inline CSS, exported and rendered; canvas uses the same widths; readable column ids.
Table column editor shows each column as a one-line summary that expands on demand; new columns open expanded.
New Line Items and Dynamic Tables come with real Description/Qty/Rate/Amount columns (50/14/18/18%, numbers right-aligned).
Totals rows editor edits label, emphasis, order, removal and adds standard rows; new Totals blocks carry Subtotal/Tax/Total rows.
New Totals blocks are a 300px right-aligned summary box.

Data Field binding picker: Enter picks the top match, arrows walk results; format follows the binding; the label follows unless the author typed one, using the standard translated label when one exists.
Data Field default label is the translated 'Invoice #'; imported fields never gain a default label.
Picking a binding, standard label or lone token renames a still-default layer (e.g. 'issue-date').
Text blocks offer '+ Insert data field…' (searchable, Enter picks top match) and start with empty text.
Clicking a field in the FIELDS tab with a Data Field selected rebinds it.
Standard document label catalog mirrors en documents.json `labels` and is kept in step by a test.
StandardLabelControl on text content, field labels, column headers and totals row labels: shows translated state with 'Use fixed text', or a searchable standard-label picker with readable key names.
Typing a standard label's exact text links it automatically; 'Use fixed text' opts out persistently; editing to another standard text relinks.
New table headers and totals rows default to standard translated labels.
Canvas chip states when translated labels show in the Preview language.
Canvas shows authored background and border on the light page; dark mode keeps the designer surface.
Canvas page has no gap between top-level blocks (matches the rendered document).
Empty containers show a visible drop zone; name badge shows on hover only; selection fade is lighter.
Image placeholders keep a minimum height.
Renderer honours authored table border-radius by switching to separate borders.
Export registers bindings under the document kind's canonical ids and fallbacks; table source options use catalog labels for every document kind.
Presets start from schema defaults (content sizing, unique names); the header preset is the standard invoice header with bindings and translated labels.
Save of a new layout adopts the saved id (no duplicate on re-save), keeps the author in the editor, updates the URL in place, and shows 'Saved <time>' plus a toast; Cancel is Close.
Editor header is one compact row and the designer fits the viewport so the page never scrolls while editing.
Inspector scrolls to top on selection change; field binding picker results do not truncate.
New shortcut catalog entries (move out/into, copy, cut, paste, duplicate, copy/paste style) with labels in all locales.
All new designer strings translated in de/es/fr/it/nl/pl/pt with regenerated xx/yy pseudo-locales; translation validation passes.
